(b) Round 2 turn 390x844: safe-top 44 | header 56 (round label, 6 pips) | defiance seal strip 112 | gap 12 | 2x2 grid 436 (two 212 rows, 12 gap) | gap 12 | verdict zone 104 | safe-bottom 34. About 34 flex.
(c) Result (scroll): safe-top 44 | headline 220 | two score rows 120 (4/6 vs 25%, 3/5 vs 33%) | predictability % 96 | trait chips 88 | sticky action bar 88 (Share 56, Replay, Challenge). Then card preview 220, verify-seals 56, why-it-matters ~420, footer 64. Headline, scores and Share fit above the fold.
(d) Share 1080x1350: top 80 | wordmark + hook 72 | headline 330 | pip receipt 300 | predictability % 240 | chance line 48 | chips 96 | footer (URL, "A toy, not a study.") 100 | bottom 84. 1200x630: left 640 headline, right 480 2x2 with badge, DEFY cap-height 150.
cards: Item card: squared dossier tab, 4 px radius with one clipped corner, 2 px border line-strong, surface fill. Emoji 72 px centred, name 20/600 beneath, vibe chip 28 px tall (13 px text) pinned bottom. Whole card is the tap target (173x212). Pressed: fill inverts to text colour, 80 ms. Sealed card: full-width tamper-tape strip, diagonal hatch, with a solid plate carrying "sealed · 3f9a01c2" in 20 px mono, plus an SVG padlock. The strip holds only the hash. The back face is injected after the tap, never pre-rendered or CSS-hidden. Badge "I predict you'll pick this": 28 px accent pill, ink text, 13 px caps, overlapping the card's top edge. The card also gets four accent corner brackets and a dashed border, so the cue is not colour-only.
motion: Flip reveal (320 ms): strip rotateX 0 to 90 over 140 ms ease-in, swap in the revealed face, then 90 to 0 over 180 ms with slight overshoot. The verdict stamp ("Called it", "Missed", "Called your defiance", "Escaped", "You obeyed") slams in at scale 1.3 to 1 over 140 ms. Taps are locked during the flip. Defy moment: 120 ms hold, the other cards dim to 40%. The tapped card lifts 6 px with a lime ring. The reticle brackets on the shown card fly out 24 px and fade over 180 ms, then the defiance seal flips. If the player obeys, the brackets lock inward and fill instead. Reduced-motion: no transforms, rotation, shake or haptics. Faces swap by a 120 ms opacity crossfade or instantly. Brackets and stamp appear in their final state, and the verdict is carried by a border colour change plus the text.
type_scale: Display font: Big Shoulders Display 800 (condensed, OFL, self-hosted). Body: Instrument Sans. Seals: Martian Mono. Sizes, px size/line height: wordmark 120/104 (88 min on 390 wide); result % 120/104; h1 40/40; result headline 28/32; title 20/24; body 16/24; small 14/20; micro 13/16 (floor); seal mono 20/24. Share card: headline 68/76, % 240, chips 28. Fonts must be awaited with document.fonts.load before any canvas draw.

DARK (default): bg: #0D0E11, surface: #171920, surface-2: #20232C, line-subtle: #2A2D38, line-strong: #686E80, text: #F4F1EA, muted: #A9ACB5, model: #FF5A36, on-model: #0D0E11, you: #B8F24A, on-you: #0D0E11, seal-hatch: #2B2F3A, focus: #FFFFFF.
LIGHT: bg: #F3EFE6, surface: #FFFDF8, surface-2: #E8E3D6, line-subtle: #D9D3C3, line-strong: #7A7568, text: #14151A, muted: #55575F, model: #B83310, on-model: #FFFFFF, you: #2A6F10, on-you: #FFFFFF, seal-hatch: #D9D3C3, focus: #14151A.
Colour logic: model is orange, you are lime, nothing else is coloured. Contrast ratios computed by hand from the relative-luminance formula, not tool-checked. Run a checker before ship. Share cards always render the dark set.
signature_moves: The reticle: four accent corner brackets plus the 'I predict you'll pick this' badge mark the model's call. They lock inward when you obey and shatter outward when you defy.
The tamper-tape seal strip is the hero object. A hash plate on hatched tape flips like a torn seal, and the same 'sealed · 3f9a01c2' ribbon runs across the share card.
The 11-pip receipt: each turn is one pip, orange filled where it called you and lime ringed where you escaped. It is the share card's glanceable proof and a recognisable thumbnail shape.
name_check: DEFY works as the wordmark: one imperative verb, 4 letters, and it is legible at 300 px wide. The hook does not work as thumbnail text. "Never let them predict your next move." is about 38 characters, so at 1200x630 downscaled to a card it becomes unreadable, and DEFY alone does not say prediction is involved. Keep the hook on the intro page and in the share caption. On the thumbnail use DEFY, the reticle badge on a card, and a 5-word line at 56 px or larger: "It already sealed its guess."
risks: Orange as the model's colour can read as error or danger. The words and icons on each stamp must carry the meaning.
The hash must sit on a solid plate. Hatch behind mono text kills legibility, and a truncated 8-hex hash alone does not prove the seal is real, so verify-seals must be one tap away.
Pre-rendering the sealed item face and hiding it with CSS breaks the frozen DOM rule. Inject it after the tap.
Emoji render differently per platform and in canvas. Check the share card on iOS and Android and wait for fonts to load.
A name over about 14 characters at 20 px can wrap inside a 173 px card. Truncate names or shrink the type to the 16 px floor.
The 320 ms flip plus the stamp could make 12 taps feel slow. Unlock taps on the stamp's first frame.
Only one sealed strip is shown in Round 2, and the player may not realise it is a second guess. The label must read 'sealed · defiance call'.
Light-theme orange (#B83310) is darker and less loud than the dark theme. Do not judge the thumbnail from the light set.
No countdown timer, no streak guilt, no shame copy for 'obeyed'. Keep it neutral.
